title: A Space owner's email editor no longer closes itself the moment it opens

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-24 00:01Z: Toni (House of Fates) opened the email editor, it popped up, and as soon as she did anything it disappeared and took her back to her manage page. Twice in a row.

detail: Cause: every Space email editor (the Marketing tab's New email pop-up, the /spaces/<slug>/marketing workspace, and the person card's message composer) mounts the shared canvas editor, and the pane handed it the marketing team's shared saved-sections library unconditionally. The canvas lists that library on mount through listSavedSections, whose gate was requireAdmin('admin', { staff: 'marketing' }). For a Space owner who is not platform staff that gate calls redirect('/feed'), and a redirect thrown from a server action navigates the whole page, so the editor vanished about a second after it opened and the pristine draft it had minted was discarded on unmount (no draft rows remain for the Space, which matches). Staff never saw it because the gate admits them. Fix: listSavedSections answers null instead of redirecting (same rule, as a yes/no), the pane gives the shared library only to the admin save path (a Space editor keeps saved sections in the browser), and the admin Email Studio workspace passes it explicitly. Probe: scripts/probes/LIVE-2523.mjs.
